stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: 21 pts for Wendy Mangelsdorf, top of the table and the sausage sizzle already fired up for the presentation.

stories.title: The Home Team
stories.detail: Wendy and Neil are flying the Mangelsdorf flag today, and Sunday lunch just got competitive.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Lovely to have Robert Oliver from Cowra GC out on the course with us today.

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: On the Charge
stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 4 & 5

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 4 & 5 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 5, 3-pointer on hole 6 - that's better

stories.title: High Low Express
stories.detail: From 4-pointer to wipe in one hole - nobody does it like this

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 4, 1-pointer on hole 5

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 6 & 7 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 4 & 5

stories.title: Technically Still Scoring
stories.detail: 4 1-pointers in a row - at least it's not a wipe

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Finals are won late and Desmond Mullins drifted 8th to 18th in exactly that stretch.
